protocol.protocol: Cross the inherited graph weights, bias and support as a whole with the frozen local write rule from either generation of the same birth. Original models were 64k direct triangle parents and one-life interspersed 8k continuations. The old card uses exactly the same 128 ordinary odor geometries, crossed private laws and actual A/B terminal probes. The new assay uses original one-life disjoint 96 geometries and 64 crossed laws, all three published support orders equally, active only and native timing. Six no-taste terminal probes branch from one common state. Retain the measured interaction of the two components because swaps change their inherited pairing.
